API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesAdd Source Ip Group
Add Source Ip Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipSourceGroups

Adds a new custom source IP group. To learn more, see Configuring Source IP Groups.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Source IP group details.

id
int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
string

Name of the IP address group or IP pool.

ipAddresses
string[]

IP addresses included in the IP group or IP pool.

description
string

Description of the IP group or IP pool.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates if the IP group is view-only (true) or is editable (false).

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA

int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
